BoundingBox.title: BoundingBox
BoundingBox.description: Axis-aligned box in page space, top-left origin, normalized to [0, 1].

CategoricalTrait.title: CategoricalTrait
CategoricalTrait.description: One of a closed set of levels. It has no unit.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description:
Printed text. On a citation-only column, this text is the ETS value.

A range list, when present, concatenates to ``text``.

Correction.title: Correction
Correction.description:
A narrow citation kept beside an interpretation.

``citation`` is the narrow printed token. The interpretation's passage is
the wider text its value was read from. The adapter uses the
interpretation value. The citation stays for tracing and highlighting.

CountTrait.title: CountTrait
CountTrait.description:
A number of things, such as young or teats.

It is never converted, so the printed unit is not checked. It is a whole number, unless
the paper prints a mean or a median of counts. ``stored_unit`` names what is counted.

ExtractionArtifact.title: ExtractionArtifact
ExtractionArtifact.description: Versioned extraction result stored for a job.

Interpretation.title: Interpretation
Interpretation.description: A value read from one citation. ``passage`` is that citation.

NumericTrait.title: NumericTrait
NumericTrait.description: A measured quantity. Each printed unit maps to the factor into ``stored_unit``.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description:
One measurement.

A citation-only field is printed text. A citation or correction is that citation, or a
correction that keeps the narrow citation beside an interpretation. A citation
or interpretation has no verbatim sibling. Its check can reject the printed
text, so it is a citation or an interpretation of one passage. The passage
fails that check, so it is not a usable column value. ``basisOfRecord``,
``aggregateMeasure``, ``centralKind``, and ``dispersionKind``
are interpretations only. A paper does not print those tokens. The adapter
uses ``centralKind`` and ``dispersionKind`` to write ``statisticalMethod``
when no phrase was stored, and ``dispersionKind`` to convert the dispersion.
The minimum and the maximum use the same factor as the trait value. One
unit covers the measurement.

``scientificName``, ``traitValue``, and ``traitUnit`` are interpretations
beside a required verbatim citation. The interpretation is omitted when the
printed token is already the value. ``traitValue`` and ``traitUnit`` are
that printed number and unit, cleaned up, not a converted pair.
``scientificName`` is another name a later taxonomy lookup can try.

The artifact does not enforce a closed set of values. An interpretation's
``value`` is any non-empty string, including ``traitCode``. An extractor may
constrain it, and the adapter decides what a value means.

Every other column a paper can state is optional. An extractor leaves it null.

SafeError.title: SafeError
SafeError.description: A short, non-sensitive description of why a job failed.

TextRange.title: TextRange
TextRange.description:
Half-open character range in one parser block.

``start`` and ``end`` are Unicode code points, the same indexes as a Python
``str``. ``end`` is greater than ``start``.

TextSpan.title: TextSpan
TextSpan.description: Word box mapped onto `TextContent.text` as a half-open character range.

TraitListEts.title: TraitListEts
TraitListEts.description: The trait list as ETS Traitlist rows, plus the list version.

version.title: Version
version.description: YYYY.MM.REVISION. The year and month the release was made, then a revision that starts at 0 and counts further releases in that month.

TraitListFull.title: TraitListFull
TraitListFull.description:
Full entries for one query.

This is not a closed list. A deprecated trait's replacement may sit outside
the selection, so it is not required to be one of these traits.

TraitlistRow.title: TraitlistRow
TraitlistRow.description: One ETS v0.10 Traitlist row. Empty columns are null.
